wake-of-gods.mapobjects.almshouse.dialog: You are too tired to visit the Alms House today.
This hero has already visited an Alms House.
A kind man greets you inside the Alms House. "Ah, my poor child, let us help you..."
"Not even a stick to warm yourself! Accept this wood."
"Not even a pot to... hold your mercury! Accept this donation."
"Not even a rock to sit on! Accept this ore."
"No sulfur to build your mage guilds? Accept this gift."
"No pretty crystals to look through? Please accept this trinket."
"No pretty gems to play with? Please accept this bauble."
"Poor wretch, not a penny to your name! Accept a few coins."
"You poor weakling! Let us give you strength."
"You frail thing! Let us teach you endurance."
"You poor inept spellcaster! Let us give you power."
"You sad ignoramus! Let us give you knowledge."
"Your lack of worldliness is pitiful! Let us teach you."
The man frowns. "This is an Alms House. We help only the poor and unfortunate."
The man smiles. "We are glad to have helped you, child."
The man beams. "Your fortunes are reversed! We are truly delighted to have helped you so much."
